checks.name: Number-field norm, F4 and quaternion relations
checks.detail: Exact finite field and matrix identities. Classification of all listed number systems is not inferred from these samples.

checks.name: sl2 closure and periodic generator
checks.detail: Exact brackets and J squared equal minus identity; written exponential proof gives all real times.

checks.name: Canonical symplectic matrix and oscillator invariants
checks.detail: Exact infinitesimal symplectic identity plus sample evaluations. Constancy of every canonical Casimir is proved in prose with coordinate test functions.

checks.name: Rational circle parametrization
checks.detail: Exact worked point and inverse parameter; density and cardinality are proof statements.

checks.name: Factorial tail bound and affine area
checks.detail: Exact finite-tail inequalities check the displayed irrationality argument; its infinite geometric bound is supplied by the written proof.

checks.name: Coordinate-ring radius rescaling
checks.detail: Exact point and polynomial substitution check; irreducibility/domain statements use the written algebraic proof.

checks.name: Correct quartic roots and V4 sign automorphisms
checks.detail: Exact arithmetic in basis 1,sqrt2,i,sqrt2 i checks all four roots and all four sign maps. Field degree is proved separately.

checks.name: Weight-four Hecke eigen-coefficients
checks.detail: Exact first100 nonconstant coefficients for T2 E4=9E4, with the required 2^(k-1) a_(n/2) term; the divisor proof establishes all n.

checks.name: Two-arc Cech constant-sheaf differential
checks.detail: Exact differential rank and quotient dimension for this cover; this is not a violation of the sheaf gluing axiom.

checks.name: Formal Laurent-polynomial braid and Hecke equations
checks.detail: All8 basis triples and4 pairs are checked exactly over Q[q,q^-1], so this finite symbolic identity holds for every nonzero q in the declared convention.

checks.name: Trefoil bracket and writhe normalization
checks.detail: Exact Temperley-Lieb Laurent calculation in the stated crossing and variable convention; knot invariance is the cited bracket theorem.

checks.name: Hyperbolic geodesic and Cayley metric factors
checks.detail: Sample evaluations check the explicit metric identity and vertical geodesic. Differentiated formulas in the entry prove the identities for all points.

checks.name: Virasoro central-cocycle arithmetic
checks.detail: 625 exact mode pairs and the low modes are checked; the written polynomial cancellation proves the unbounded Jacobi identity.

checks.name: Triangle boundary and filling homology
checks.detail: Exact mod-two ranks support the finite cell example. General sphere and surface fundamental groups use the explicit covering and van Kampen arguments, not these ranks.

checks.name: Exterior forms and oriented determinant
checks.detail: Pullbacks along the unit circle and a wedge determinant are checked. The exact integrals are constants times2pi; nonexactness follows from the written period proof.

checks.name: Affine tetrahedron mass
checks.detail: Exact barycentric, monomial and centroid values agree; no quadrature tolerance is used.

checks.name: Exact Poisson CG iteration
checks.detail: Fraction arithmetic reaches the stated solution in exactly two steps. The general SPD requirement is proved by the displayed sum of squares.

checks.name: Toroidal complex, Hamiltonian cycle and Morse indices
checks.detail: Exact boundary ranks, all12 cycle vertices/edges and four diagonal Hessian indices are checked for the newly declared toy complex.

checks.name: Normalized Rademacher sums
checks.detail: Finite characteristic-function errors decrease in the displayed sample and the fourth cumulant scales exactly. The finite-variance limit theorem is proved analytically in the entry.

checks.name: Skew-matrix and gauge-patch checks
checks.detail: Exact odd skew determinant plus patch-coefficient identity. Flux4pi g follows from the stated elementary integral; no monopole existence is inferred.

checks.name: Finite Ising normalization and detailed balance
checks.detail: All16 transition entries, stationary pair flows and the correlation are checked exactly with rational probabilities.

checks.name: Parameter shift and non-descent counterexample
checks.detail: Analytic formulas checked numerically, including a strict loss increase for the recovered heuristic update; no empirical training claim.

checks.name: Bell dephasing density matrix and blind marginals
checks.detail: Exact rational states at q=0,1/4,1 check normalization, positivity eigenvalues, both marginals and joint XX/ZZ. Kraus proof establishes complete positivity for all0≤q≤1.

checks.name: Additive-model sensitivity rank and null directions
checks.detail: Exact scalar and four-output ranks, all four null directions and the independently informative two-equation example.

scope: Finite certificates and arithmetic checks accompany the entries. Their details distinguish exact identities, numerical samples and proof-only general statements.
